jobs.text: I lead frontend initiatives and contribute across the stack on Lyft Business, collaborating with designers, product managers, and engineers.
Co-created an AI design assistant in Figma, contributing software engineering and collaborating with designers on the product experience.
Worked on engineering for an AI-curated image discovery product, participating in design discussions and interaction refinement with the team.
Developed frontend experiences for creative web3 tools, including Buenoverse, with product collaboration and improvements informed by the community.
Built interactive web experiences and games, with attention to visual fidelity and the details of how each interaction feels.
Worked on digital product interfaces, usability, and user experience in collaboration with engineering teams.
Co-founded a studio designing and developing websites and e-commerce experiences for small and medium-sized businesses.
